title: The Silence of Anderlecht
author: Mara Joubert
blurb: Edmund Reyes, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
